name: Piyestra Super Hybrid Quilt Cover Foam Mattress
description: 5-inch triple-layer Piyestra Super Hybrid foam mattress with a soft quilted fabric cover. Engineered for balanced body support, comfort, and backed by a 7-year manufacturer warranty.
details: The Piyestra Super Hybrid Foam Mattress (by Damro) is engineered to deliver a balanced combination of firm orthopaedic support and plush sleeping comfort for Sri Lankan homes. Constructed with a triple-layer core—combining a high-density bonded foam base with soft comfort foam layers—it promotes proper spinal alignment and improved airflow for effective heat release. Finished with a durable, diamond-quilted fabric cover, this 5-inch mattress offers long-lasting resilience and comes backed by a 7-year manufacturer warranty.
